fundamentals.name: Netflix, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.

judgment.summary: Strong growth and margins are somewhat offset by a high valuation and significant debt.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter missed EPS estimates by 1.4%; next earnings date is 2026-07-16.
positives: Revenue growth 16.2% YoY and earnings growth 86.4% YoY indicate robust expansion.
Profit margin 28.5% and return on equity 48.5% demonstrate strong profitability and efficiency.
Free cash flow (TTM) of $25.99B provides substantial financial flexibility.
Analyst consensus is 'buy' with a mean target of $114.56, suggesting upside potential.
negatives: Trailing P/E of 26.59 and Forward P/E of 21.45 suggest a premium valuation.
Debt/Equity ratio of 53.79% indicates a notable level of leverage.
Last quarter's EPS missed estimates by 1.4%, a minor but present concern.

news.paragraph: Netflix has seen a notable downturn, with recent reports indicating it's dropping more than the general market. This follows news of the company withdrawing from an acquisition, which the market apparently approved of, and a chart analysis suggesting a continued downward trend. The stock's recent performance has exposed two potential outcomes over the past year, leaving investors with mixed signals.
